name: T&T - Combat Assistant
description:
# T&T - Combat Assistant

**Combat automation for Roll20 D&D 2014 & 2024.**

Combat Assistant reads attacks, spells, damage, healing, saving throws and initiative from supported Roll20 D&D character sheets and turns them into interactive combat tools for the GM and players.

## Features

- **Attack & Spell Capture:** Reads supported attack, damage and healing rolls and creates interactive cards to apply their effects to selected tokens.
- **Automatic Damage:** Checks AC and applies damage while accounting for Temporary HP, Resistances, Immunities and Vulnerabilities.
- **Healing & Temporary HP:** Apply captured or manual healing directly to selected tokens.
- **Group Saving Throws:** Roll saving throws for groups of selected tokens with support for Normal, Advantage and Disadvantage rolls.
- **Group Initiative:** Roll initiative for multiple selected creatures and automatically update the Roll20 Turn Order.
- **Animated Combat:** Optional Roll20 FX for projectiles, hits, healing, explosions, beams, breath attacks and other combat effects.
- **Area of Effect Automation:** Creates movable markers for Radius, Sphere, Cylinder, Emanation, Cube, Square, Cone and Line effects and automatically detects affected tokens.
- **Automatic AoE Saves:** Resolve saving throws and damage for creatures caught inside an area effect.
- **Concentration System:** Tracks concentration spells, concentration saves, duration and persistent AoE markers, removing their effects when concentration ends.
- **Turn Tracker:** Customizable combat rounds, turn cards, Next Turn controls, optional Auto Focus, Round Counter and animated Turn Marker.
- **Movement Tracker:** Tracks movement during a creature's turn and supports Dash movement.
- **Combat Menu:** Reads attacks from a character sheet and provides compact chat controls for rolling them.
- **Spell Menu:** Reads and organizes available spells directly from supported character sheets.
- **Resource Manager:** Displays and manages limited-use character resources and spell slots directly from Combat Assistant and Turn cards.
- **Player Combat Controls:** Optional player attack, healing, saving throw, initiative, AoE, resource and turn controls.
- **Range Checking:** Optional validation of attack and spell target distance.
- **NPC Combat Tools:** Group saves, initiative, attacks, spells, resources, movement tracking and optional defeated-NPC removal.
- **D&D 2014 & 2024 Support:** Designed to work with both official Roll20 D&D sheet generations.

## Added in v1.2.15

- **Compact Sheet:** `!ca sheet` provides a token-bound HP/AC, attributes, skills and saving-throw view.
- **Special Actions:** `!ca combat-special` lists available Bonus, Reaction, Free, Legendary and Mythic actions.
- **Prepared Spells:** Open preparation controls from `!ca spells` or `!ca spells-prepared`; locked Always Prepared and item spells are shown separately from editable spells.
- **2024 Prepared-only Filter:** Honors the supported sheet filter or CA's stricter `2024 Prepared Spells Only` option while keeping unprepared entries in the preparation manager.
- **Magic Item Spells:** Improved exact-ID item spell matching and conservative resource/charge handling.
- **Auto-hit & Concentration:** Improved native multi-projectile Magic Missile and Witch Bolt follow-up tracking, including deduplication and safer resource consumption.

For automatic spell resource tracking, enable **Chat Monitoring** and **Consume Spell Slots**. Ambiguous item source, cost or spell level is never guessed. The v1.2.15 Magic Missile batch timeout is 1 second and should be tested with upcasts and slow Roll20 message delivery.

## Basic Commands

- `!ca menu` - Open the main Combat Assistant menu.
- `!ca settings` - Open configuration and feature toggles.
- `!ca help` - Show command help.
- `!ca sheet` - Open Compact Sheet for the selected token.
- `!ca combat` - Show attacks for the selected token.
- `!ca combat-special` - Show supported special actions for the selected token.
- `!ca spells` - Show spells for the selected token.
- `!ca spells-prepared` - Manage prepared spells.
- `!ca resources` - Show resources and spell slots.
- `!ca save <ability>` - Roll saving throws for selected tokens.
- `!ca init` - Roll initiative for selected tokens.
- `!ca player-init` - Initiative for a controlled player token.
- `!ca deal manual <damage> <type>` - Apply manual damage.
- `!ca heal manual <hp|temp> <value>` - Apply healing or Temporary HP.
- `!ca turn` - Show the current Turn card.
- `!ca turnnext` - Advance to the next combat turn.

Combat Assistant also accepts `!combatAssistant` and `!combat-assistant`.
